notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard library, and adapter-supplied application FOM, standard MIM, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It subscribes to standard HLAreportException, triggers a typed NameNotFound with an undefined object-class lookup, toggles Exception Reporting through standard HLAsetSwitches, and verifies enabled delivery, disabled suppression, reliable RTI-originated callback metadata, the textual service/exception parameters, and the reported federate handle. The pinned MIM declares HLAreportException HLAreliable/Receive; the TCK verifies reliable transport and observes the report only on the non-timestamped receiveInteraction route. With callback region conveyance enabled, the exercised report must carry one callback-scoped region whose only dimension is HLAfederate and whose half-open point bounds equal [Normalize Federate Handle(HLAfederate parameter), +1). The transport/order and region witnesses are scoped to this report class and lookup failure; they do not establish the global MOM rules or cover every other Table 7 report interaction. It uses no provider-specific name, registry, header, or internal state.
